criteria.description: The workbook opens and contains the native reporting objects requested by the task.
An Excel Table preserves exactly the eight supplied source events and six source fields.
A genuine PivotCache binds to that source table/range with the six source-field identities.
The native PivotTable places Region in rows and Program in columns.
Quarter is a page filter selected to exactly 2024Q2.
Participants and Spend are native SUM measures.
The PivotCache is refreshable and configured to refresh when the workbook opens.
GETPIVOTDATA-linked KPI cells have the Excel-calculated participant, spend, and split-specific focus values.
A clustered-column PivotChart is bound to the native PivotTable; a regular range chart does not qualify.
